verdict.rationale: Radar's Fraud Insights analytics show fraud-rate trends over time and which attribute combinations drive fraud on the merchant's own traffic. That is outcome-level measurement, not measurement of the model itself. Sandbox test cards only simulate risk levels and are not a shadow-mode trial of new rules or models. Missing for 10: model precision/recall or false-positive metrics on merchant traffic, shadow-mode or backtest evaluation of new rules/models before they take over decisions, and independent corroboration.
